title: Apply for or upgrade an individual property licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for or upgrade an individual property licence, which allows you to work as an agent in specific property areas.
intro:
An individual property licence lets you work as an agent in one or more of the following areas:

If eligible, you can:
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person to hold a licence.
Not be a ‘disqualified person’ under the Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 or another Act administered by the NSW Minister for Fair Trading.
Meet the qualification and training requirements for the type of licence.
Prove that the registered office is in NSW, or within 50km of the NSW border if you hold a current licence or authority from that jurisdiction.
what_you_need: Details of your employment within the real estate and property industry (if applicable).
The following documents ready for uploading in PDF, JPG or PNG format.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply or upgrade online' button.
Follow the prompts to apply for or upgrade an individual property licence.
Download and complete the Individual Property Licence Application – PDF.
Gather the required supporting documents as indicated on the form.
Visit a service centre to submit your application.

more_info.text: Check the continuing professional development (CPD) requirements for your licence class.
If you already hold a licence in another state/territory or New Zealand, you may be eligible to apply under mutual recognition.

faqs.q: What does an individual property licence allow me to do?
faqs.a: An individual property licence lets you work as an agent in one or more specific areas.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements to apply for this licence?
faqs.a: You must be aged 18 or over, be a fit and proper person, not be a ‘disqualified person’ under relevant Acts, and meet the qualification and training requirements for the licence type.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, details of your employment in the real estate and property industry (if applicable), your fee payment, and several documents ready for uploading (PDF, JPG, or PNG).
